newsitem.title: USA: Interline says hit with bankruptcy petition.
newsitem.headline: Interline says hit with bankruptcy petition.

text.p: Interline Resources Corp said that on July 29 a petition for involuntary bankruptcy was filed against the company and its subsidiaries.

The two companies which filed the petition are currently involved in litigation with the company on contractual matters unrelated to the bankruptcy proceeding, a news release issued by Interline said.
The company said it intends to vigorously contest the involuntary bankruptcy proceeding.
The company said it has been informed that the petitioners will seek the appointment of a trustee to manage the company.
The company said it will also vigorously contest the appointment of a trustee.

One of the petitioners, Genesis Petroleum Inc, a subsidiary of Quaker State Resources, has obtained a judgment against the company for the company's failure to pay under an agreement in which the company agreed to purchase Genesis' interests in a used oil refinery, the news release said.
The other petitioner is Petroleum Systems Inc, the news release said.
